d: Kendriy kaibinet ki baithak men desh ke vikas aur buniyadi suvidhaon ke vistar se jure panch bare phaislon ko manjuri di gaee. inmen dhanchagat sanrachna ke vikas se jure bare upkarnon ke nirman ke lie vishesh yojna aur dakaghron ke aadhunikikran par vishesh jor diya gaya hai. vahin, jharkhand vidhanasbha men esaaaeeaar ko lekar sankalp prastav parit kiya gaya. is mudde par charcha ke dauran satta paksh aur vipaksh ne ek-dusre ko ghera. sadan men aadivasiyon ki jamin ki kathit lut aur ghuspaithiyon ka mudda bhi pramukhta se utha. idhar, rajyapal se prashikshu aaeepies adhikariyon ne…
